definitions.explanation: A person who serves in an army. A neutral, general term for military personnel, especially rank-and-file soldiers rather than officers.

examples.japanese: {兵士|へいし}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兵士|へいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: Many soldiers lost their lives on the battlefield.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{兵士|へいし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The young soldiers were sent to the front lines after undergoing harsh training.

notes:
A standard, neutral term for soldiers. Used in both historical and modern military contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兵士|へいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (dispatch soldiers)
- {兵士|へいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧ (soldier training)
- ⟦{負傷|ふしょう}した→負傷する：28056_fushousuru⟧{兵士|へいし} (wounded soldier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {兵士|へいし}: soldier (neutral, general — both historical and modern)
- ⟦{軍人|ぐんじん}→軍人：02994_gunjin⟧: military person (includes officers, broader than {兵士|へいし})
- ⟦{兵隊|へいたい}→兵隊：27666_heitai⟧: soldier (slightly more colloquial, can feel old-fashioned)
- ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: warrior (specifically Japanese samurai/warrior class)
